messages.subject: Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed()
parts:
Hi, 

I'm doing a spatial analysis using a BYM model with binomial (model below). I've successfully run the model or 210 other urban areas but am running into an issue with this specific area where the error is that inla has crashed. I've pasted the output as far back as I can get it. Thoughts?

ERROR:   Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

MODEL:   form_city <- formula(denial ~ loan_income_ratio + as.factor(applicant_sex_cat) + f(group_id, model = "bym", graph = paste0('neighbors_', 35620, '.adj')))
 
  inla_city <- inla(form_city,
                    family = 'binomial',
